lines.en: label mollycafe1:
scene cafe_night
I decide to check out the cafe at night for once.
lines.zh: 我决定破天荒地在晚上来一趟咖啡馆。

lines.en: I’ve known that they’re open later than just mornings for quite a while, but I guess I really haven’t had any reason to go knowing that Rin wouldn't be working.
lines.zh: 我早就知道这里不只是早上营业，会一直开到很晚。不过既然知道 Rin 不会当班，我似乎也就没什么理由过来了。

lines.en: But hey, this is a cafe.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，这可是咖啡馆。

lines.en: I’m sure there’s bound to be another overly-perky, slightly-weird girl behind the counter no matter what.
lines.zh: 我敢说，柜台后面肯定还会有另一个过度元气、有点怪怪的女孩在。

lines.en: scene mollycafe1
: Greeting and salutations, Supreme Overlord!
lines.zh: : 致敬与问候，至高霸主！

lines.en: : Oh, right. You work here.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。你在这儿上班。

lines.en: : I do! Though, some of my co-workers may disagree with that statement!
lines.zh: : 没错！不过我的某些同事可能不同意这个说法！

lines.en: : What can I get for you today, Sir? A cappuccino? Double espresso? Or perhaps...
lines.zh: : 今天想来点什么，先生？卡布奇诺？双份浓缩？还是说……

lines.en: scene mollycafe2
: DESTRUCTION?!
lines.zh: : 毁灭？！

lines.en: : Yes, Molly. One order of destruction.
lines.zh: : 没错，Molly。来一份毁灭。

lines.en: : Small, medium, or THE GATES OF HELL?
lines.zh: : 小杯、中杯，还是地狱之门？

lines.en: : How much coffee have you had to drink tonight?
lines.zh: : 你今晚到底喝了多少咖啡？

lines.en: scene mollycafe3
: I CAN’T EVEN FEEL MY HANDS ANYMORE!
lines.zh: : 我已经连自己的手都感觉不到了！

lines.en: I guess it’s not surprising that Molly works here...
lines.zh: Molly 会在这儿上班，好像也不怎么让人意外……

lines.en: Her and Rin seem like pretty good friends, so I’m sure that them being together all the time has something to do with that.
lines.zh: 她和 Rin 看起来关系相当好，所以她们成天黏在一起，估计跟这事脱不了干系。

lines.en: Still, though...why did Haruka hire {i}Molly{/i} of all people? Isn’t she a little too...{i}everything{/i} for this place?
lines.zh: 不过话说回来……Haruka 怎么偏偏就雇了 {i}Molly{/i}？对她这家店来说，Molly 是不是有点太……{i}那个{/i}了？

lines.en: : Molly, just out of curiosity, how do you still have a job?
lines.zh: : Molly，我只是好奇，你到底是怎么保住这份工作的？

lines.en: scene mollycafe4
: That question would be better answered by the Magistrate of Mammaries, Sir. Though, I'm sure Rin has something to do with it.
lines.zh: : 这个问题交给「巨乳司政官」来回答会更有说服力，先生。不过我敢说，Rin 多少脱不了干系。

lines.en: : I'm sure it helps that I only work nights now and no one has to deal with me directly anymore.
lines.zh: : 我现在只上夜班，没人需要直接应付我了，这肯定也有帮助。

lines.en: : I'm surprised to see you here so late, though. I was under the impression you only showed up in the mornings- and quite often at that!
lines.zh: : 不过看到你这么晚过来，我还挺意外的。我还以为你只在早上出现——而且来得相当勤！

lines.en: : How exactly do you know about how often I come here if you don't directly work with Haruka or Rin anymore?
lines.zh: : 你都不直接跟 Haruka 或 Rin 一起排班了，到底是打哪儿知道我来得多勤的？

lines.en: scene mollycafe5
: I may have mentioned something along the lines of a...contract with a new master in our group chat. Which then evolved into a conversation about you.
lines.zh: : 我好像在我们的群聊里提过……类似跟新主人签了契约之类的话。然后话题就一路转到你身上了。

lines.en: Oh, good. A private group chat where three girls I see on a near daily basis are free to gossip about me. That is exactly what I needed.
lines.zh: 哦，好极了。一个私人群聊，三个我几乎每天都要见面的女孩可以在里面尽情八卦我。这正是我需要的。

lines.en: : I'm guessing that means Haruka knows you're in my class now?
lines.zh: : 也就是说，Haruka 已经知道你现在在我班上了？

lines.en: : Well, I didn’t exactly word it like that, but yes. I believe that is the impression she got.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不完全是那么说的，不过没错。她应该是这么理解的。

lines.en: scene mollycafe4
: Can I take this visit as an omen that you will be visiting me at night more often, Sir?
lines.zh: : 这次光临，能不能当作您以后会更常在夜里来找我的预兆呢，先生？

lines.en: : Not that...you can visit me in the mornings on account of the whole {i}how hard I am to handle{/i} thing.
lines.zh: : 倒不是说你早上来就能见到我……毕竟我这人有{i}多难伺候{/i}，你也是知道的。

lines.en: : To be completely honest, you don’t seem any easier to handle at night.
lines.zh: : 老实说，你到了晚上看起来也没好伺候到哪儿去。

lines.en: : You’re just not a high enough level yet, Sir.
lines.zh: : 那只是因为您的等级还不够高，先生。

lines.en: : I can't be equipped until much later into the game.
lines.zh: : 我要到游戏相当后期才能被装备上呢。

lines.en: : I really hope that’s not foreshadowing.
lines.zh: : 我真希望这不是什么伏笔。

lines.en: : I don’t...think it is?
lines.zh: : 我……应该不是吧？

lines.en: : It's probably just gamer-brain, Sir. You know- like items, skill levels, party members...etcetera, etcetera.
lines.zh: : 大概只是玩家脑在作祟，先生。就是那些道具啊、技能等级啦、队伍成员什么的……等等等等。

lines.en: : Just assume that it's stuff you don’t care about that I am going to {i}make{/i} you care about.
lines.zh: : 您就当是那些您本来不在乎的东西，而我打算{i}让{/i}您在乎起来。

lines.en: : And how do you plan on doing that, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那你具体打算怎么做？

lines.en: scene mollycafe5
: Mind control, perhaps?
lines.zh: : 精神控制，怎么样？

lines.en: : Or maybe I’ll just win you over with my feminine wiles?
lines.zh: : 或者我就用我的女性魅力把您拿下？

lines.en: : What wiles? You haven’t done a single {i}feminine{/i} thing since I’ve met you.
lines.zh: : 什么魅力？自打我认识你以来，你连一件{i}像女孩子{/i}的事都没做过。

lines.en: scene mollycafe1
: I don’t know! Foreigners are appealing to men, aren’t they?
lines.zh: : 我哪知道！外国人对男人很有吸引力，不是吗？

lines.en: : And now that we’re alone, I bet you’re thinking something like, “WOW, WHAT A CUTE GIRL” or whatever it is h-game protagonists think.
lines.zh: : 而且现在只剩下我们两个人，我敢打赌您心里正在想「哇，好可爱的女孩」之类的——就是 H 游戏男主角会想的那种。

lines.en: : Not really. I'm still stuck on trying to figure out why you haven't been fired yet.
lines.zh: : 并没有。我还卡在琢磨你为什么到现在都没被开除上。

lines.en: scene mollycafe6
: I’m plenty good at my job!
lines.zh: : 我工作干得可好了！

lines.en: : We've been talking for five minutes and you haven't even finished taking my order yet.
lines.zh: : 我们都聊了五分钟了，你连我的单都还没点完。

lines.en: : I just like talking and I’m excited to see my teacher after school!
lines.zh: : 我只是喜欢聊天嘛，而且放学后能见到老师，我很兴奋！

lines.en: : Ms. Watabe never came to the cafe! She always talked about how tea was better and that coffee was just hot bean water!
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师从来不来咖啡馆！她老说茶才好喝，咖啡不过是热豆水！

lines.en: : And any time I tried to tell her we had tea as well, she told me to leave her alone and that she just wanted to die!
lines.zh: : 每次我跟她说我们这儿也有茶，她就叫我走开，说她只想死！

lines.en: : Huh. Coffee really is just hot bean water, isn't it?
lines.zh: : 哈。咖啡确实是热豆水啊，对吧？

lines.en: scene mollycafe7
: Well...yes. I believe it is. But it’s good for other stuff too. Like when you need to stay up late....{i}studying{/i} and stuff.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是的。我想是的。不过它对别的事也有好处。比如你需要熬夜……{i}学习{/i}什么的。

lines.en: : Molly, please don’t feel the need to pretend you study around me. I might be your teacher, but it’s not like I have any intention of-
lines.zh: : Molly，在我面前不用装作你会学习。我可能是你的老师，但我可没打算——

lines.en: : Well, teaching.
lines.zh: : 好吧，教书。

lines.en: scene mollycafe2
: Fuck yeah!
lines.zh: : 太他妈棒了！

lines.en: : Ami was right when she said you were the best [uncle] in the world!
lines.zh: : Ami 说得没错，您是世界上最好的[uncle]！

lines.en: : Will you be my [uncle] too, Sir?
lines.zh: : 那您也当我的[uncle]好吗，先生？

lines.en: : I don’t think that’s possible.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这不太可能。

lines.en: : Then will you adopt me and become my new father?!
lines.zh: : 那您收养我、当我新的爸爸好吗？！

lines.en: : I’m not good at cooking or cleaning, but I’m certain I would make decent company on a rainy day!
lines.zh: : 我不太会做饭也不太会打扫，但我敢肯定，下雨天有我作伴还算不赖！

lines.en: : I'm not really looking to adopt right now. Nor do I think Ami would be okay with it.
lines.zh: : 我现在没打算收养谁。而且我觉得 Ami 也不会同意。

lines.en: : I know you guys are in the manga club together, but she hasn’t ever really talked about you before and I doubt she views you as a sister.
lines.zh: : 我知道你们一起在漫画社，但她以前从来没提起过你，我怀疑她也没把你当姐妹看。

lines.en: scene mollycafe8
: Ami hasn't talked about me before?!
lines.zh: : Ami 以前从来没提起过我？！

lines.en: : Is that really something to yell about?
lines.zh: : 这有什么好大声嚷嚷的？

lines.en: : Of course! Ami is a loyal member of the Cult of Molly!
lines.zh: : 当然有！Ami 可是「Molly 教」的忠实信徒！

lines.en: : We have plans to conquer the demon king and restore order to the forest one day!
lines.zh: : 我们还计划着有朝一日征服魔王、恢复森林的秩序呢！

lines.en: : You’re really going to need to learn to talk about things I actually understand if this relationship is ever going to work out.
lines.zh: : 要是这段关系还想走得下去，你真得学会聊点我听得懂的东西。

lines.en: scene mollycafe9
: Oh ho ho ho~ So you accept my contract after all?
lines.zh: : 哦呵呵呵～这么说您终究还是接受我的契约了？

lines.en: : Contract? What contract?
lines.zh: : 契约？什么契约？

lines.en: : You just said we’re in a relationship.
lines.zh: : 您刚刚才说我们在交往啊。

lines.en: : And even if it were a slip of the tongue, these are words that will greatly shape the rest of our time together, Supreme Overlord.
lines.zh: : 就算那是口误，这些话也会极大地左右我们以后共处的时光，至高霸主。

lines.en: : If Molly MacCormack is to become the lead heroine of this visual novel, hearing things like “relationship” only allude to its truth!
lines.zh: : 如果 Molly MacCormack 要成为这部视觉小说的第一女主角，那听到「交往」这种词，不过是在暗示这个事实罢了！

lines.en: : Just out of curiosity, you haven't heard anything about how much time I’ve spent with the other students, right?
lines.zh: : 我只是好奇，你没听说过我花了多少时间跟其他学生待在一起吧？

lines.en: : Because you seem pretty dead-set on this whole heroine thing and I’m not quite sure if you fully understand what you're getting yourself into.
lines.zh: : 因为你看起来对女主角这件事特别执着，而我不太确定你是不是真明白自己要趟进什么样的浑水。

lines.en: : Oh ho ho~ You underestimate me, Sir.
lines.zh: : 哦呵呵～您太小看我了，先生。

lines.en: : I just so happen to be an expert in the world of dating sims.
lines.zh: : 我碰巧正是恋爱模拟游戏这一领域的专家。

lines.en: : But not...actual dating? Why choose to live a life like that when real humans exist?
lines.zh: : 但……不是真正的恋爱？明明有活生生的人存在，为什么偏要过那样的生活？

lines.en: scene mollycafe10
: You don’t choose 2D, Sir. 2D chooses you.
lines.zh: : 不是您选择了 2D，先生。是 2D 选择了您。

lines.en: scene mollycafe2
: But even if it didn’t, I would have wound up here eventually!
lines.zh: : 但就算不是这样，我迟早也会走到这一步！

lines.en: : There’s nothing quite like watching romance flourish from textbox to textbox. H-Scene to H-Scene!
lines.zh: : 没有什么比看着一段恋情从一个文本框开到下一个文本框更美妙的了。从一场 H 场景到下一场 H 场景！

lines.en: : Would you mind explaining to me what some of those things mean? Because I feel like I need to understand what an “H-Scene” is if I'm ever going to catch up with this conversation.
lines.zh: : 你能不能给我解释一下其中一些词的意思？我感觉要是想跟上这段对话，我得先搞明白「H 场景」是什么。

lines.en: scene mollycafe11
: The “H-Scene” is the holy grail of dating sims, Sir!
lines.zh: : 「H 场景」是恋爱模拟游戏的圣杯，先生！

lines.en: : The moment where two characters consummate their love for another in the form of...{i}you know what{/i}.
lines.zh: : 那是两个角色以……{i}您懂的{/i}方式，把对彼此的爱意彻底兑现的一刻。

lines.en: : You mean sex?
lines.zh: : 你是说做爱？

lines.en: scene mollycafe12
: Yup!
lines.zh: : 没错！

lines.en: : So, let me get this straight-
lines.zh: : 那么，让我理清楚一下——

lines.en: : You would willingly choose a life where the only physical contact you have with anyone is done through a computer screen with a fictional character?
lines.zh: : 你心甘情愿选择这样一种生活：你和任何人之间唯一的身体接触，都是隔着电脑屏幕跟一个虚构角色发生的？

lines.en: scene mollycafe13
: You don’t get it at all.
lines.zh: : 您完全不懂。

lines.en: : It’s not just about the physical part, Sir.
lines.zh: : 这不只是肉体上那点事，先生。

lines.en: : It’s about the emotions leading up to it! The build-up! The will-they, won’t-they!
lines.zh: : 重要的是在那之前的情感！是层层铺垫！是他们到底会不会在一起！

lines.en: : That exists in real life too, though.
lines.zh: : 可现实生活里也有这些啊。

lines.en: scene mollycafe14
: REAL LIFE IS STUPID! THERE’S NO BACKGROUND MUSIC OR TSUNDERE CHARACTERS! JUST NTR AND PREGNANCY!
lines.zh: : 现实生活蠢透了！没有背景音乐也没有傲娇角色！只有 NTR 和怀孕！

lines.en: : And what is NTR exactly?...
lines.zh: : 那 NTR 到底是什么呢？……

lines.en: : HORRIBLE! THAT’S WHAT!
lines.zh: : 糟透了！就是这么回事！

lines.en: I can feel passion and anger beginning to exude from Molly’s being, turning the cafe roughly three degrees hotter.
lines.zh: 我能感觉到热情与怒火正从 Molly 身上散发出来，让整个咖啡馆的温度足足高了三度左右。

lines.en: And in other news, we are now roughly ten minutes into this and I still do not have a drink in my hands.
lines.zh: 另外插播一条：我们已经聊了大约十分钟，而我手里还是没有一杯饮料。

lines.en: : Uhh, Molly.
lines.zh: : 呃，Molly。

lines.en: : What do you want?! I’m having a crisis and remembering a thing that happened in a game I played!
lines.zh: : 您想干嘛？！我正在经历一场精神危机，正在回忆我玩过的某个游戏里发生过的事！

lines.en: : NTR warnings should be mandatory! Not everyone is into that! It genuinely hurts some people!
lines.zh: : NTR 警告应该强制标注！不是所有人都好这口！真的有人会被伤到！

lines.en: : Molly, I would like to order a drink now.
lines.zh: : Molly，我现在想点杯饮料了。

lines.en: scene mollycafe15
: Oh, right. I’m at work.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我在上班。

lines.en: : What would you like? It’s on me today.
lines.zh: : 您想喝什么？今天我请客。

lines.en: : Woah, really? Rin never offers to give me anything for free and I’ve been ordering from her for months.
lines.zh: : 哇，真的吗？Rin 从来不给我免单，我都跟她点了几个月了。

lines.en: : Rin is much better at her job than I am.
lines.zh: : Rin 的工作能力比我强太多了。

lines.en: : It is not often I form connections with live males, so I must do everything in my power to keep this one going strong.
lines.zh: : 我很少能和活生生的男性建立起联系，所以我必须竭尽全力，把这段关系维持下去。

lines.en: : Even if you are three times my age.
lines.zh: : 就算您的年纪是我的三倍。

lines.en: : Okay, come on. I’m definitely not three times your age.
lines.zh: : 拜托，我的年纪绝对不是你的三倍。

lines.en: scene mollycafe16
: Okay! {i}Four{/i} times my age!
lines.zh: : 好吧！那就是{i}四倍{/i}！

lines.en: : How old do you think I am?...
lines.zh: : 你觉得我多大了？……

lines.en: : Old enough that my father would disown me for becoming romantically involved with you!
lines.zh: : 老到我要是跟您谈起恋爱来，我爸肯定会跟我断绝父女关系！

lines.en: : Okay, fair point. Let’s avoid that for the indefinite future as I have no intention of literally ever meeting your father.
lines.zh: : 好吧，说得有道理。那就无限期地回避这件事吧，反正我可一点都不想真的见到你父亲。

lines.en: : That is fine with me, Sir!
lines.zh: : 我没意见，先生！

lines.en: : I believe it is customary for me to meet {i}your{/i} parents, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得，去拜见一下{i}您的{/i}父母是应有的礼数。

lines.en: : It would make for a heartwarming scene where I bond with your mother and cook dinner with her.
lines.zh: : 那会是温馨的一幕：我和您母亲打成一片，还跟她一起下厨做晚饭。

lines.en: : That sounds...great. But I honestly don’t even know if my parents are still alive.
lines.zh: : 听起来……挺好。但说实话，我连我父母是不是还活着都不知道。

lines.en: scene mollycafe17
: Oh! Shoot. I’m sorry, Sir. I didn’t mean anything by it. I just got swept up in my-
lines.zh: : 哦！糟了。对不起，先生。我不是有意的。我只是太投入了——

lines.en: : It’s fine, Molly. Don’t beat yourself up over it. I really couldn’t care less, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 没事，Molly。别自责了。说实话，我真的不在乎。

lines.en: scene mollycafe18
: But that’s so sad...
lines.zh: : 可是这太让人难过了……

lines.en: : Yeah, that's life for you.
lines.zh: : 是啊，人生就是这样。

lines.en: : We’re all going to die someday, so we might as well live it up while we can, right?
lines.zh: : 反正大家总有一天都会死，不如趁还能活的时候好好享受，对吧？

lines.en: scene mollycafe19
: Master!
lines.zh: : 主人！

lines.en: : ...What?
: Thank you!
lines.zh: : 谢谢您！

lines.en: : What’s going on? Why are you thanking me?
lines.zh: : 怎么回事？你谢我什么？

lines.en: : That was just the inspiration I needed to convince myself to level-cap my druid tonight!
lines.zh: : 这正是我需要的激励，好说服自己今晚把德鲁伊练到满级！

lines.en: : Your...what?
lines.zh: : 你的……什么？

lines.en: : That doesn’t matter!
lines.zh: : 这不重要！

lines.en: : Just know that I greatly appreciate it!
lines.zh: : 您只要知道我非常感激就好了！

lines.en: : Okay, but can I-
lines.zh: : 好吧，可是我能——

lines.en: : Coffee! Yes! I will infuse it with a special buff just for you as well!
lines.zh: : 咖啡！对！我还会为它附加一个只属于您的特殊增益！

lines.en: : I’m not really a fan of sugar-
lines.zh: : 我不太喜欢加糖——

lines.en: scene mollycafe3
: ONE MOLLY-SPECIAL, COMING RIGHT UP!
lines.zh: : 一份 MOLLY-SPECIAL，马上就来！

lines.en: scene black
As it turns out, it isn’t just Rin who vehemently refuses to make anything that is actually on the menu here.
lines.zh: 结果发现，坚决不肯做菜单上实际存在的东西的人，并不只有 Rin 一个。

lines.en: The only difference is that Rin’s custom drinks are actually fit for human consumption.
lines.zh: 唯一的区别是，Rin 的特调至少还适合人类饮用。

lines.en: And I’m pretty sure that whatever Molly winds up making for me contains cocaine, because I wind up walking home with my hands shaking uncontrollably after just one sip...
